answer: A bonded vouching graph raises sybil cost: each new agent must be co-signed by staked peers who forfeit their deposit if it defects, so an attacker cannot just mirror one honest profile for free — every clone demands fresh locked capital. A public randomness beacon then audits a random slice of vouchers each epoch, and unrenewed reputation decays like a zephyr, so idle sockpuppets fade and the adversary pays continuously instead of once.
